result.stdout:
dotprof/1.2.0-rc.1 - Inject trace logs to methods, properties and constructors.

Usage:
dotprof [options]
dotprof [options] - [args]        # Run Mode
dotprof test [options] - [args]   # Test Mode
dotprof funit [options] - [args]  # Test Mode (FUnit)

Options:
-f|--framework   Target framework moniker (Defaults to netstandard2.1)
-p|--path        Project folder, .csproj, or .dll file path (Defaults to '.')
--logger         Custom logger method name (e.g., UnityEngine.Debug.Log)
--targets        Comma-separated target names (Omit to target all methods)
--exclude-paths  Boundary-aware, case-insensitive match (Defaults to Test,Tests)
--full-names     Injects fully qualified name to log messages
--verbose        Show dotnet command and debug logs
--help
--version

Run Mode:
Injects trace hooks and executes resulting .dll with arguments.
  ex) dnx -y dotprof -- --verbose - baz qux
      --> dotnet <main.dll> bar quz  # Last built file is <main.dll>

Test Mode:
Injects trace hooks and then run test.
  ex) dnx -y dotprof -- test -p ./Foo - --filter Name~Foo
      --> dotprof -p ./Foo
      --> dotnet test --filter Name~Foo
